scope: Stock worker and two veneers; actual C connection/mode getters, pointer queue drain/stop/null records, 16-bit consumed fields, unknown types, invalid handles, all mode bytes, mode transitions, reloaded pointers/queue after provider mutation, ownership/free order and full-word veneer returns
limitations: Actual serialized sender and helpers execute; queue/free, semaphore API, BAE8 send, returning error logger and both log backends are intercepted; the service data anchor is address-only.
Fault addresses are compared without access-width/granularity identity; source byte reads avoid alignment assumptions.
Original instructions, cycle timing, physical-device and whole-image behavior remain unproven.
